protocol.purpose: Test one bounded family of public-information equity-growth and competitor-derived rules after the preregistered Generation 1 family failed to beat SPY in both development and validation.
protocol.claim_boundary: Generation 1 results and broad market history are known, so no historical interval is fresh. Generation 2 may identify a historically supported SHADOW_ONLY policy; it cannot prove future profitability or reproduce an options strategy from daily ETF prices.

data.primary_provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close, one uniform retrieval vintage
data.null_policy: Use only dates common to every symbol in the applicable panel; never forward fill.
data.revision_boundary: Adjusted close is a revised total-return research series, not a point-in-time archive. Hash every raw response and normalized panel.
data.survivorship_boundary: Today-surviving ETFs and today-known universes create survivorship and universe-selection risk. No constituent-level claim is made.

execution.signal_timing: Compute the signal from information available after adjusted close t.
execution.rebalance_timing: Apply the decision at adjusted close t+1.
execution.first_position_return: The new weights first earn the t+1 to t+2 adjusted-close return.
execution.five_session_rules: Use the first of five native anchors in discovery; all five anchors are required before a historical pass.
execution.monthly_rules: Use a fixed 21-session cadence in discovery; all 21 native anchors are required before a historical pass.
execution.initial_entry_and_terminal_treatment: Identical engine and treatment for candidates and benchmarks; slice metrics represent a continuous live policy, while rolling-window robustness will explicitly rebase boundary costs.

candidate_registry.formula: Daily: hold 100% QQQ only if QQQ adjusted close is strictly above its inclusive trailing 200-session simple average and its 63-session log return is positive; otherwise hold BIL.

Every five sessions: for QQQ and SPY compute the mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess log return. An asset is eligible only if above its inclusive SMA200 and its mean score is positive. Hold the higher-scoring eligible asset; hold BIL if neither qualifies.
Every 21 sessions hold 100% of the strongest SPY/QQQ/IWM ETF by mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess log return, without an absolute-momentum cash gate.
Every 21 sessions hold 100% of the strongest SPY/QQQ/IWM ETF only if both its mean 63/126/252 score and 252-session BIL-excess log return are positive; otherwise hold BIL.
Every 21 sessions hold 100% of the strongest original-nine Sector SPDR by mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess log return, without an absolute-momentum cash gate.
Every 21 sessions hold the strongest original-nine Sector SPDR only if its mean score and 252-session BIL-excess log return are positive; otherwise hold BIL.

Daily clean-room adaptation of the MIT AEGIS-Q deterministic fallback: assign +1/-1 to SPY 5-session return, 20-session return, distance from SMA50, and distance from SMA200; hold SPY when the sum is at least 2, otherwise BIL.

Daily clean-room proxy of AlphaPilot's public daily rule: hold SPY only when close>SMA20>SMA50, five-session simple return exceeds 1%, and sample standard deviation of the last ten daily returns is below 5%; otherwise BIL.

separate_diagnostics.formula: Daily: if QQQ is above its inclusive SMA200 and 63-session momentum is positive, allocate 70% TQQQ/30% BIL when annualized 20-session QQQ volatility is at most 25%, otherwise 100% QQQ; hold BIL when the regime fails.
separate_diagnostics.difference_from_source: Uses adjusted-close signal and close-to-close execution with BIL return. The source used split-adjusted OHLC, prior-close signal to next-open execution, 5 bp one-way costs, and zero cash return. Therefore this is an implementation proxy, not an exact result reproduction.

trial_accounting.rule: Every later formula, parameter, universe, manual rejection, LLM suggestion, bug-fixed rerun, cost, or schedule variant is appended before evaluation and counted in deflated statistics.

selection.objective: Among candidates passing all pre-robustness gates, maximize the smaller annualized log-growth advantage over SPY across development and validation; then break ties by validation BIL-excess Sharpe, drawdown, and identifier.
selection.recent_interval_role: May veto a hard safety failure after selection, but cannot improve a score, rescue a failure, or break a tie.

raw_return: net annualized log growth exceeds SPY in development and validation
validation annualized log-growth advantage is at least 0.50 percentage points after base costs
median raw excess is positive in annual-origin 252/504/756-session families
at least 60% of windows in every horizon family beat SPY
risk: validation annualized volatility does not exceed SPY
validation drawdown is no worse than SPY by over two percentage points
validation BIL-excess Sharpe exceeds frozen Finly and SPY volatility targeting by at least 0.10
validation drawdown is no worse than frozen Finly by over two points and never worse than 15%
robustness_after_preselection: raw-return conclusion retains sign at 5/10/25 bp one-way costs
raw-return conclusion retains sign across every native rebalance anchor
Deflated-Sharpe probability is at least 0.95 using at least 75 trials
shared circular-block familywise p-value is at most 0.05 at 5/20/60-session blocks
authenticated Alpaca overlap reconciliation passes frozen tolerances for every used symbol

dataset.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close

qqq_regime_momentum_long_only.mechanism: QQQ only when price is above its inclusive 200-session simple average and 63-session momentum is positive; otherwise BIL

qqq_spy_regime_rotation.mechanism: Choose QQQ or SPY by 63/126/252 relative strength only when the asset is above its own 200-session average and BIL-excess score is positive

equity_relative_strength_always.mechanism: Always hold the strongest of SPY/QQQ/IWM by mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess momentum

equity_relative_strength_absolute.mechanism: Hold the strongest of SPY/QQQ/IWM only when both mean multi-horizon and 252-session BIL-excess momentum are positive; otherwise BIL

sector_top1_always.mechanism: Always hold the strongest original-nine sector ETF by mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess momentum

sector_top1_absolute.mechanism: Hold the strongest original-nine sector ETF only when its mean and 252-session BIL-excess momentum are positive; otherwise BIL

aegis_direction_proxy_spy.mechanism: Clean-room MIT adaptation of AEGIS-Q's deterministic fallback: score SPY five- and 20-session returns plus distances from SMA50/SMA200 as +/-1; hold SPY at score >=2, otherwise BIL

alphapilot_daily_gate_proxy.mechanism: Clean-room proxy of AlphaPilot's public daily rule: SPY only when close>SMA20>SMA50, five-session return exceeds 1%, and 10-session daily volatility is below 5%; otherwise BIL

next_required_stage: No Generation 2 candidate passed every preregistered gate. Append any bounded Generation 3 formula before inspecting its output.
